mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 2100 thousand units signals strong household demand and economic momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening supply-side capacity and labor market stress, indicating an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of cases when both INDPRO < 108.0 and UNRATE > 4.8%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing real rate uncertainty and equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient but is not significant (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 357,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of all observations, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll employment above 134,500 thousand persons signals strong labor market demand, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 50% of cases when PAYEMS > 134500, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% annualized, combined with rising unemployment, signals a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate investment and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
